limitations: The Rodero substrate is an adult-derived static heart model, not a pediatric patient study.
The heart-only substrate does not establish a body surface, chest wall, spine, or diaphragm.
Geometry checks do not validate ultrasound physics, motion, Doppler, artifacts, or diagnosis.
